title: Cataloging the Hall
event: A crew wheels in modular catalog shelving and industrial leaflet dispensers stamped with the word "Betriebsform"; the automatic labeler jams, shreds and ejects a wind of catalog leaflets that scatter and drift across the unfinished concrete floor and pile against a mirrored steel column.
consequence: a dense scatter of printed "Betriebsform" leaflets forming a low pile against a steel column
nextHook: the printed leaflets will be repurposed as product labels and attract food-related signage (Althochdeutsche Sprache / fleisc)

title: Butchered Catalog

nextHook: safety crews will respond by marking and labeling the leaking material with formal H- und P-Sätze hazard stickers

title: Labeling the Leak
event: A safety team arrives and begins affixing bright hazard stickers and handwritten H- and P-codes to the crates and leaflets; they tape off the aisle with yellow hazard tape and place a small open spill kit and a fine white absorbent powder next to the leaking crate.
consequence: yellow quarantine tape stretched across the aisle, multiple H-/P-stickered crates and a small mound of white absorbent powder with one set of small boot prints leading away
nextHook: the quarantine draws a crowd of the public who will press and test the barrier (Public)

title: Pressing Against the Tape
event: A mixed crowd of shoppers and on-site workers arrives and begins pressing against and pulling at the quarantine tape; some film on phones, one person angrily rips down a leaflet, and a dropped backpack skids across concrete, colliding with a crate and knocking loose a hazard sticker which flutters away.
consequence: a torn and sagging quarantine tape, a knocked-clean crate with a dislodged hazard sticker fluttering on the floor, a spilled backpack with receipts and product flyers scattered
nextHook: the disorder focuses attention and draws a more violent rupture in the atrium, coinciding with an explosive event and a hulking presence (Terrorism leads to visible rupture)

title: Rupture in the Atrium

consequence: a blackened scorch gouge on the concrete beside the steel column, toppled metal shelving, smoke and a scattered pile of torn leaflets and flyers around the creature's feet
